-- annotated/com/x/BUpMonitor.java --
package com.x;

// Shape of chihuahua BChiUpMonitor.ensureUps: creates each child into a local and places it on a grid.
public class BUpMonitor extends BComponent
{
  private void ensureUps()
  {
    int seq = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < UP_DATA.length; i++)
    {
      String slotName = (String) UP_DATA[i][0];
      if (get(slotName) != null) { seq++; continue; }
      BUp up = new BUp();
      add(slotName, up);
      BComponent child = (BComponent) get(slotName);
      child.add("wsAnnotation", BWsAnnotation.make(3 + seq % 8 * 14, 3 + seq / 8 * 10, 8), Flags.READONLY);
      seq++;
    }
  }
}
-- list/com/x/Plan.java --
package com.x;

// Not slot adds of a new component: collection adds, value-typed properties, addAll.
// One shape per method, and no method mentions the placement slot, so none is silenced by the guard.
public class Plan
{
  void collect(List<BComponent> out)
  {
    out.add(new BFolder());
    out.add(0, new BFolder());
  }

  void values(BComponent c)
  {
    c.add("status", new BStatusNumeric());
    c.add("since", new BAbsTime());
  }

  void bulk(BComponent c)
  {
    c.addAll(items, new BFolder());
  }
}
-- positive/com/x/BSyncService.java --
package com.x;

// Shape of DashboardFord BFordDashboardService.doSyncInventory: creates every missing node, places none.
public class BSyncService extends BAbstractService
{
  public void doSyncInventory()
  {
    for (Op op : plan.ops)
    {
      BComponent parent = resolve(op.parent);
      if (parent == null) continue;
      parent.add(op.name, create(op.type));
    }
  }

  private static BComponent create(String type)
  {
    return (BComponent) Sys.getType(type).getInstance();
  }
}
